# Lexirus

Lexirus is an offline Russian–Chinese dictionary. Main features: fuzzy search with configurable sound rules, lookup statistics, redesigned entry layout, Russian major Level 4 and Level 8 question banks, and organized fixed expressions. Core features run on-device without registration.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/lexirus/id6819521030
Support: https://lexirus.cn/support/
Crash guide: https://lexirus.cn/support/crash/
Privacy: https://lexirus.cn/privacy/

The crash tool processes JSON-format Lexirus .ips logs locally (also .json/.txt), up to 5 MB. It extracts allowlisted technical fields, excluding names, contact details, search history, favorites, notes, device identifiers and the original file and filename. Users review and download Lexirus-diagnostic.json, then manually attach it to an email to xzwdev@163.com. The website does not receive uploads. Email contains the sender address and voluntarily included content. Mail links do not attach files or confirm delivery. Website hosting providers may process network metadata. Legacy text crash logs and JetsamEvent are unsupported.

感谢 @我要吃大西瓜 的反馈，帮助我们改善了 iOS 15.8 系列上的崩溃问题。
